--- README.txt ---
MeshGate incident bundle — revision 3

An XDP mesh-gateway policy was recovered with its original ELF object, map
snapshot, target BTF profile, loader state and historical wire capture.

Run:
  ./meshgate <ethernet-frame-hex>

The program performs an offline replay only.  It does not invoke bpf(), does
not attach a program, and does not need root.  `edge_vmlinux.btf` is the
captured target type profile used by the recovery loader.  The PCAP records a
previous deployment epoch and is context evidence, not a replay answer.

Bundle files:
  mesh_policy.bpf.o     CO-RE eBPF ET_REL object
  edge_vmlinux.btf      target BTF profile
  mesh_maps.snapshot    captured HASH/ARRAY map state
  mesh_loader.state     incident loader state
  mesh_traffic.pcap     prior mesh telemetry
  release_blob.bin      authenticated release material
